source_row.stem: A nurse is monitoring a critically ill client's central venous oxygen saturation (ScvO2). A low ScvO2 value generally suggests:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A normal finding that would not usually prompt any further hemodynamic assessment or action","B":"Excessive oxygen delivery relative to tissue demand, the opposite of what a low ScvO2 value reflects","C":"Inadequate oxygen delivery relative to tissue demand, prompting further hemodynamic assessment","D":"Improved cardiac output, an interpretation not typically associated with a falling ScvO2 value"}}
source_row.rationale: A low central venous oxygen saturation (ScvO2) suggests inadequate oxygen delivery relative to tissue demand, often used in sepsis resuscitation protocols to guide further hemodynamic intervention.
source_row.source_name: Surviving Sepsis Campaign — ScvO2 Monitoring Guidance
